wod.title: Power Clean + Front Squat, Pendlay Row & EMOM

parts.name: Build
parts.prescription:
E1.5 x 6
2 BB Power Clean + 2 Front Squat @ 75%

parts.name: Build
parts.prescription:
Heavy BB "Pendlay" Row - Descending reps: 8-8-6-6 (Go heavier each set)
b/t sets: 30's Heavy Plank Hold

parts.name: Engine
parts.prescription:
20min EMOM (5 rounds)
1st min - 8 Burpees
2nd min - 16 Russian KB Swings
3rd min - 24 Sit-ups
4th min - 64 Double Unders

targets.why: Front rack positioning for power cleans and front squats in A
Explosive pull and hinge for cleans in A and rows/swings in B and C
Squat depth in A and bounding volume for double unders in C
Rigid trunk in plank holds and strict lat pull in Pendlay rows in B

blocks.name: Game: Cone Flip Face-Off
items: Divide class into 2 teams; scatter 20 cones across the floor
Team A flips cones up, Team B flips cones down for 90-second rounds
Must perform 1 burpee before each cone flip
Play 2 rounds; losing team completes 5 jump squats

blocks.name: Hips & Front Rack Flow
items: 5 Bootstrappers with a 2-second hold at bottom
10 Elbow rotations in empty barbell front rack
20 Single unders or pogo hops focusing on quick rebound

blocks.name: Barbell Primer
items: 5 Pendlay rows focusing on flat back and explosive floor pull
3 Power clean + front squat complexes ramping toward working weight

rx.line: E1.5M x 6: 2 Power Cleans + 2 Front Squats @ 75% 1RM

scaled.line: E1.5M x 6: 2 Hang Power Cleans + 2 Front Squats @ moderate load (55-65%)

senior.line: E1.5M x 6: 2 DB Hang Power Cleans + 2 DB Goblet Squats @ controlled tempo

cues: Drive elbows fast and high on the catch of the clean.
Brace core and keep torso upright during front squats.

faults.fix: Snap elbows forward and up aggressively as the bar meets the shoulders.

faults.fault: Chest collapsing forward in the front squat
faults.fix: Drive elbows high toward the ceiling on the ascent.

substitutions: Dumbbells for barbell if wrist/shoulder mobility is restricted

rx.line: BB Pendlay Row 8-8-6-6 (build to heavy) + 30s Weighted Plank between sets

scaled.line: BB or DB Bent-Over Row 8-8-6-6 + 30s Unweighted Plank between sets

senior.line: DB Chest-Supported or Bent Row 4 x 8-10 + 20-30s Elevated Plank

cues: Reset the barbell dead on the floor before every rep.
Keep torso rigid and parallel to the floor without hip jerking.

faults.fault: Yanking with upper body and rising up during the pull
faults.fix: Lock hips and spine angle in place; pull strictly with upper back.

substitutions: Incline chest-supported DB row to protect lower back

rx.line: EMOM 20: 8 Burpees / 16 KB Swings (24/16 kg) / 24 Sit-ups / 64 Double Unders

scaled.line: EMOM 20: 6 Up-Downs / 16 Swings (16/12 kg) / 16 Sit-ups / 45 Single Unders

senior.line: EMOM 20: 5 Elevated Up-Downs / 12 Light Swings / 12 Sit-ups / 30 Plate Hops

rxPlus.line: EMOM 20: 10 Burpees / 20 KB Swings (32/24 kg) / 24 GHD Sit-ups / 80 Double Unders

cues: Aim for at least 15-20 seconds of rest on every minute.
Drive hips explosively and stay grounded on KB swings.
Stay tall and relaxed through shoulders on rope work.

faults.fault: Squatting the kettlebell rather than hip hinging
faults.fix: Send hips back with soft knees and snap glutes forward at lockout.

faults.fault: Jumping forward or kicking feet back on double unders
faults.fix: Stay vertical on the balls of your feet and rotate from wrists.

substitutions: Plate hops or single skips for double unders
Elevated box burpees for floor burpees
